## Change

## Why this is the only source change

The mock server setup you described (async server startup with `.await`, fluent builder for method/path/query params via `Mock::given(...)`/`.respond_with(...)`, and retrieving the endpoint as a URI string via `server.uri()`) all lives in `mountpoint-s3-fs/tests/mock_s3_tests.rs` and its `mod common` — both under the `tests/` directory. Per your constraint, I did **not** touch those; the verification system will apply the test patch that swaps the `httpmock` synchronous API (`MockServer::start()`, `server.mock(|when, then| ...)`, `server.address()`) for the `wiremock` async equivalents.

I verified there are no `httpmock`/`MockServer` references anywhere in source files outside `tests/`, so `Cargo.toml` was the sole source-side dependency needing the swap.

Note: `cargo` is not installed in this environment, so I couldn't refresh `Cargo.lock` or compile — the build/lockfile resolution will happen in the verification harness. The three target scenarios (503 throttling, 409 lookup error, 418 read error) are exercised by the patched test file against the new `wiremock`-based helper.
